familyTheme: Use doubly stochastic residual-mixing matrices (mHC / Sinkhorn-Knopp) to stabilize multi-stream computations across training-like and transfer scenarios.

derivedTasks.title: Similar - mHC Residual Mixing Stability Audit
derivedTasks.goal: Project residual logits to doubly stochastic matrices with Sinkhorn-Knopp, run one mHC-style stream-mixing pass, and report stability metrics.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The task directly requires the mHC core operation: log-space Sinkhorn projection plus residual stream mixing under doubly stochastic constraints.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Expert Router Balance Projection
derivedTasks.goal: Convert expert-routing logits into doubly stochastic dispatch matrices and summarize load-balance and entropy diagnostics.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Sinkhorn-based doubly stochastic projection is transferred from residual-mixing matrices to expert router balancing while preserving the same mathematical constraints.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Sensor Stream Fusion Consistency
derivedTasks.goal: Apply mHC-style stream mixing to multi-sensor sequence features and output consistency and drift metrics.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: The same doubly stochastic residual mixing used in mHC is adapted to cross-sensor stream fusion, testing generalization beyond language-model residual blocks.

derivedTasks.title: Transfer - Forecast Ensemble Stabilization
derivedTasks.goal: Stabilize multi-model forecast streams with Sinkhorn-projected blend matrices and report variance and calibration deltas.
derivedTasks.skillBenefitRationale: Doubly stochastic mHC-style mixing is migrated to ensemble forecasting, where controlled stream blending reduces variance spikes while preserving aggregate scale.
